'''Mumian''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lollo Warehouse}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Mumian)
:'''Mumian:''' Oh, these dehumidifiers are quite effective!
:{{DIcon}} Dehumidifiers?
:'''Mumian:''' Yeah. It's a must-have when delivering packages in [[Whining Aix's Mire]].
:'''Mumian:''' Without it, even the delivery box can't shelter packages from the penetrating fog.
:'''Mumian:''' I have a stellar reputation for making dehumidifiers. I can assure that!
:'''Mumian:''' Look! I made these dehumidifier from [[Violet Coral]] ground into powder, mixed with [[Angelica]]!
:'''Mumian:''' Angelica repels insects, and Violet Coral powder absorbs water... With these, we don't have to fear the heavy fog anymore.
{{Dialogue End}}
